## CRM Follow-up Automation
Finds the deals going quiet and drafts the follow-up before they die.

Each weekday morning it reads your deals sheet (deal, company, contact, owner, stage, value, last_contact, topic, last_note), finds deals that have gone quiet for their stage, ranks them by value x days silent, and emails each rep their list with drafted follow-ups.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/crm-followup-automation
